name: Hexagon Nutrition
description: Hexagon Nutrition Limited is a research-oriented nutrition company engaged in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of nutrition products. It operates across the nutrition value chain offering micronutrient premixes, therapeutic and clinical nutrition products, and food fortification solutions. The company provides customised vitamin and mineral premixes to FMCG companies domestically and internationally, and supplies micronutrient powders for public health programmes.
purpose: Offer for sale — proceeds go to existing investors (₹138.87 Cr)
highlights: Integrated nutrition company from R&D to marketing
Supplier to global public health programmes
Revenue from premixes, clinical nutrition, preventive healthcare

name: Vahh Chemicals
description: Vahh Chemicals Limited manufactures, trades, supplies and blends textile auxiliary chemicals used across various stages of textile processing — pre-treatment, dyeing, printing and finishing. They primarily serve dyeing and printing houses with customised chemical solutions. The company offers 114 SKUs for cotton, polyester, silk, and synthetic blends. Also operates a nutrition subsidiary offering nutraceutical products.
purpose: Working capital (₹5.84 Cr), new manufacturing facility in Surat (₹1.93 Cr), loan repayment (₹1.84 Cr), general corporate purposes (₹2.02 Cr)
highlights: 114 SKUs across cotton, polyester, silk & blends
New manufacturing facility planned in Surat

name: Utkal Speciality Industries India
description: Utkal Speciality Industries India Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of paper-based products and packaging materials. The company offers a range of products used in food service and packaging applications, including paper plates, paper cups, paper glasses, paper dosa plates, paper bowls, tissue paper, pizza and sweets boxes, and wrap paper for sandwiches and burgers. Its products are available in different sizes, designs, thicknesses, and quality variants to meet the requirements of various customer segments.
purpose: Working capital (₹5.31 Cr, 15.37%); Repayment of borrowings (₹11 Cr, 31.85%); New manufacturing facility at Khurda, Odisha (₹9.6 Cr, 27.79%); General corporate purposes (₹8.63 Cr, 24.99%)
risks: The business has high working capital requirements and may need additional funding to support operations.
Delays in customer payments or inability to secure financing could adversely affect business performance.
The proposed new manufacturing facility may not achieve expected capacity utilisation or profitability.
Additional production capacity may not be fully absorbed by market demand, impacting returns on investment.
A portion of the planned capital expenditure depends on external bank financing, which is yet to be fully drawn.

name: Susan Electricals India
description: Susan Electricals India Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of aluminium and copper-based electrical winding wires, conductors and cables in various specifications, sizes and configurations. Its product portfolio includes low tension (LT) cables, LT aerial bunched (AB) cables, high tension (HT) cables, winding aluminium wires and strips, winding copper wires and strips, and aluminium conductors. The company primarily supplies its products to state-owned electricity distribution utilities (DISCOMs), infrastructure and EPC companies.
purpose: Expansion of existing manufacturing facility at Sahibabad, UP (7.72 Cr, 12.82%); Funding working capital requirements (33 Cr, 54.80%); General corporate purposes (20 Cr, 32.38%)
risks: A significant portion of revenue depends on government-owned electricity distribution companies (DISCOMs).
The business relies on winning and executing government and institutional tenders.
Revenue is dependent on a limited number of customers, making customer concentration a risk.
The company faces intense competition from existing and potential players in the industry.
Failure to execute expansion and growth strategies could adversely affect business performance.

name: Horizon Reclaim (India)
description: Horizon Reclaim (India) Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of reclaimed rubber, which is produced by recycling used rubber materials such as old tyres, rubber tubes, tread peelings and industrial rubber scrap, including EPDM rubber. The company offers products across three main categories: Natural Rubber Reclaim, Synthetic Rubber Reclaim (including EPDM and Butyl Reclaim Rubber), and Crumb Rubber, which are used in applications such as footwear, automotive components, floor mats, construction products, road construction and sports surfaces.
purpose: Repayment/pre-payment of outstanding borrowings (26.7 Cr, 49.20%); Installation of additional plant & machinery (9.43 Cr, 17.38%); Working capital requirements (6 Cr, 11.05%); General corporate purposes (12.14 Cr, 22.37%)
risks: A significant portion of revenue comes from a limited number of customers.
Operations depend on a limited number of suppliers for key raw materials.
Rising raw material prices or supply disruptions could affect profitability.
Failure to meet product quality standards may lead to order cancellations and loss of business.
Under-utilisation of manufacturing capacity could adversely impact future financial performance.
